output.summary: The win-rate collapse is mainly a measurement and mix artifact. From 2026-04-15, a lowered MQL threshold plus automatic opportunity creation put about 750 low-score (40-59) opportunities into the closed pool at a 3.3% win rate. 61% of those losses were auto-closed as Unresponsive. Excluding that band, Q3 win rate is 29.4% against 31% in Q1, and non-marketing win rate is flat. Rep activity is up, and comp, attrition and competitor pricing do not explain the drop. Whether LeadSpring leads are intrinsically worse is unresolved. Re-baseline reporting and stop auto-creating field opportunities for 40-59 leads. The CEO's accountability and PIP program would punish the wrong party.
